status: CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution; public data follows documented author analysis comparison convention; source questionnaire-specific instructions not independently located.
attribution: Kupffer, Frick, and Wetzel, Detecting Careless Responding in Multidimensional Forced-Choice Questionnaires
transformations: Only MT columns, renamed IDs as one-based row indices, melt to long statement-level raw rank; BT numerical design mapping; no item text, other subtests or demographics. Preserve missing ranks. Small sample is first 100 source rows, not a random or independent sample.
interpretation: Rank values are original observed statement-level rank codes; author comparison convention treats smaller rank as preferred but source questionnaire-specific instructions not independently located. Do not treat partial rank as complete or silently infer missing ranks. Same cohort across subtests; no duplication as independent samples. Distinct block-position statement identifiers do not assert identity across blocks.
comparison_validation: reTri defines first preferred as second rank minus first rank greater than zero; our comparison response is identical for all complete and partial observed pairs, with NA when either rank is missing. 70,140 full pairs (1,476 missing); 6,000 small pairs (49 missing). Roundtrip current public FCData; no people or blocks dropped.
identifier_provenance: B01_1 denotes first position in original MT01 block; use within-block occurrence identifiers; repeated stimulus identity across blocks is not asserted.
